policy: Training-only negative exclusions, manually selected before training. Keep all lexical labels and recordings unchanged. Never apply these exclusions to reported evaluation scores.

groups.reason: Same stress and identical spoken -ться/-тся ending; spelling does not supply an acoustic contrast.
Conservative exclusion of potentially indistinguishable unstressed -ом/-ам after a hard consonant. This is a phonetic risk annotation, not a claim that individual corpus clips were listened to.

implementation: Do not put excluded forms in the same metric episode; mask only their competing auxiliary-class logits. Do not merge classes, alter test labels or lower evaluation thresholds.
